name: set_lights
description: Turn room lights on or off

name: open_app
description: Open an installed application like Safari, Mail or Spotify (only real app names, not websites)

name: open_url
description: Open a web address in the browser. Use this for any website or domain like wikipedia.org, never open_app

name: take_screenshot
description: Save a screenshot to the Desktop

name: say_text
description: Speak text aloud with the Mac voice. Use when asked to say, speak or announce something (e.g. 'say hello' or 'sag hallo')
